title: ASD-STE100 procedure vs description handling
description: As a technical writer, I want Limatus to tell procedural text (steps, numbered instructions) from descriptive text and apply the correct rule set per topic, so that procedure limits and description limits never cross-fire. Spec first: mode detection behavior in Gherkin before implementation.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Epic complete: procedure-vs-description handling spec-first, per-topic detection and limits landed. Suites: 198 pytest, 34 features / 110 scenarios, 6/6 evals.
